caption: The drawing contains several natural elements arranged repeatedly across a light beige background. It features multiple brown tree branches with clusters of green leaves of varying sizes and shapes growing from them. The branches are adorned with small bunches of round, red berries and pale yellow grapes. Near the center of the composition, there is a cluster of three round fruits resembling peaches, colored with gradients of red, orange, yellow, and purple. The vines and leaves are primarily green, with occasional tendrils extending outward in a curling fashion. The background is plain, with no additional detail or pattern. The composition is rectangular, bordered by a white margin.
title: Wall Paper
